threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep saying 'the tube' when everyone knows it's just 'the Overground' around here. And you still look confused by the bus routes.
Caught the N47 last night; two blokes were arguing over who'd seen the most obscure band at The Old Kent. Typical South London midnight vibe.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a family of wild boars crossing my street, completely unbothered by the traffic. Just another day in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you stumble upon a spontaneous rooftop yoga session while the scent of currywurst wafts through the air. It's a unique blend of Berlin life.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to pack snacks for a BART delay—it's never just a minute. This week, I saw folks munching chips while waiting for rescue.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 with a guy singing off-key about the weather while a woman next to him started selling homemade masks. Classic SF mashup.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia only sleeps; locals know the real nightlife blooms in quiet squares after 10 PM.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still ask for a ‘café con leche’ instead of just a ‘café’. The locals have their shortcuts down.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You’ll spot the newbies at the local market, fumbling with cash while everyone else knows the swipe-and-run routine.
The 63 bus last night had a guy loudly convincing everyone he was the next big garage artist, while half the passengers just nodded off.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw the bakery owner hand a fresh loaf to a kid on a bike while arguing with the pizza guy over the best tomato sauce. That’s Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you can find mini-donkey rides at some street festivals. Hilarious and totally unexpected!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their casual shrug when the BART's down – while newcomers lose their minds over delays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy chatting with his reflection in the bus window, pretending they were on a talk show. Totally unfazed by the chaos outside.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just pop into a trendy bar and find a spot anytime. Good luck getting any space at La Monda without a reservation!

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their habit of apologizing for their Spanish, even when it's perfectly fine.
